## Problem / Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it enables.

## Proposed Solution

How you envision this working. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they are less ideal.

## Scope

Which part of CockpitOS does this affect?

- [ ] Firmware (C++ / ESP32)
- [ ] Compile Tool (CockpitOS-START.py)
- [ ] Label Creator (LabelCreator-START.py)
- [ ] Setup Tool (Setup-START.py)
- [ ] Label sets / mappings
- [ ] Hardware support
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references, or related issues.
